title: How to write an address (& address formatting examples)
content: # Addressing the issue: how to write an address & address formatting examples. How to write an address can depend on where in the world you are, where your recipient is, and even the type of address you’re writing. ## How to format addresses. Typically, an address includes the recipient's name, their street address (also known as Address Line 1), city, state (or province), postal code, and country. Each element should be written on a separate line, starting with the recipient’s name and ending with the country if it's an international address. For example, in the United States, here's how to format addresses:. When thinking about how an address should be written for an apartment, the format typically starts with the recipient’s name on the first line. For correct address formatting for a PO Box, begin with the recipient’s name on the first line.
